introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent, feet hip-width apart. Place your arms at your sides, palms pressing gently into the mat.

Inhale deeply, press through your feet to lift your hips off the floor. Let your chest open and gently draw it toward your chin, creating a natural arch in your back. Keep your shoulders grounded and your gaze upward. 

Hold the pose for a few breaths. With each inhale, lengthen through your spine; with each exhale, relax into the stretch.
name: BRIDGE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Tighten your abdominal muscles.
Inhale to lengthen through your spine. Exhale to relax into the stretch.
Lift your one leg up if it's too easy for you.
This is a great exercise to target your legs, core and gluteus.

introduce:
Start on hands and knees. Put your knees and toes together.

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, sit your hips back to your heels, arms reaching forward. Rest your forehead, soften your elbows, and lower your chest close to the floor.

Breathe slowly through your nose; with each exhale, release and sink a little deeper.

If you find this difficult, try bringing your knees slightly apart; listen to your body and find what feels best.
name: CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears.
Please keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back.
This exercise gently stretches your upper back, shoulders, hips and legs.
Inhale to allow your belly to expand into your thighs. Exhale to soften into the pose.

introduce:
Lie down on your back with your legs extended. Relax your spine and gently press your lower back into the floor. 

Inhale, lift your knees toward your chest. Exhale, hug your knees gently.

Hold the position without holding your breath. Inhale as you lengthen your spine. Exhale as you soften your shoulders and hips.
name: DOUBLE KNEES TO CHEST

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Hold on your thighs instead if you have knee injuries.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your lower back muscles.
It helps to restore flexibility to your lower back.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your shoulders and hips.

introduce:
Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder-width apart. Turn your left foot left, right foot slightly inward.

Inhale, raise your arms to the sides at shoulder height, palms down, and lengthen your spine upward. Exhale, shift hips right and bend torso left until your left hand to your left shin or the floor. Inhale, stretch your right arm toward the ceiling, and gaze at it.

Hold this position. Inhale and exhale for several breaths, focusing on the sensation of stretching and the lengthening of your spine.
name: TRIANGLE POSE LEFT

tips.text: Please keep your chest facing forward.
Please keep your arms and legs straight during the exercise.
If you feel it's too hard, put your left hand on your left leg instead of the floor.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.

introduce:
Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder-width apart. Turn your right foot left, left foot slightly inward

Inhale, raise your arms to the sides at shoulder height, palms down, and lengthen your spine upward. Exhale, shift hips left and bend torso right until your right hand to your right shin or the floor. Inhale, stretch your left arm toward the ceiling, and gaze at it.

Hold this position. Inhale and exhale for several breaths, focusing on the sensation of stretching and the lengthening of your spine.
name: TRIANGLE POSE RIGHT

tips.text: Please keep your chest facing forward.
Please keep your arms and legs straight during the exercise.
If you feel it\'s too hard, put your right hand on your right leg instead of the floor.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to deepen the stretch.

introduce:
Kneel with your knees hip-width apart.

Inhale to engage your lower belly, lift through the chest, and keep both your arms on your hips. Exhale as you arch your back backward and downward, slide your palms on your heels. Draw your shoulders down and gently press hips forward. Gently lower the head and neck.

Hold this position. With every inhale, raise the chest up and spine in, and relax the body with exhale.
name: CAMEL

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your belly engaged.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the chest opening.
This pose stretches your chest and abdomen.
This pose can improve your spinal flexibility.

introduce:
Start with your legs wide apart. Fold your upper body forward. 

Try to press your hands to the floor as much as possible. Release and repeat.

Exhale when you press your hands down, and inhale when you release. This exercise stretches the back of your legs.
name: WIDE LEG HAMSTRING STRETCH

tips.text: Try to press your hands to the floor as much as possible.
Keep your back straight.
Keep your legs straight.
Exhale when you press your hands down, and inhale when you release.
This exercise stretches the back of your legs.

introduce:
Lie on your stomach with your legs extended and your arms by your sides. 

As you inhale, lift your head, chest, arms, and legs off the ground, firming your shoulder blades onto your back. Imagine someone grasping your hands, gently pulling you back, to come up higher.

Hold this position. Use the inhale to support the lift of your head, chest, arms, and legs.
name: LOCUST POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your pubic bone on the floor when lifting your legs.
Inhale to lift higher. Exhale to release your tension.
This exercise tones your buttocks and strengthens your back muscles.

introduce:
Stand with your feet hip-width apart, draw your belly in, and roll your shoulders back and down.

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale and hinge forward from your hips, keeping your spine long. Place your hands on your shins.

Hold the position with slow, deep breaths through your nose. Inhale to extend the spine, exhale to relax and release deeper into the fold.
name: HALF FORWARD BEND

tips.text: Bend from your hips instead of your waist.
Keep your legs straight but don\'t lock your knees.
Focus on keeping your back flat and lengthening your spine.
Inhale to extend the spine, exhale to release deeper into the fold.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings.
This exercise strengthens your back.

introduce:
Stand upright with your arms by your sides. Interlock your fingers and turn your palms upward. 

Inhale as you raise your arms overhead and lift your heels. Balance on your toes and lengthen through your whole body. Hold the pose with slow, steady breaths. Feel your shoulders relax and your shoulder blades sink. 

Exhale, lower your heels and arms back to the starting position.
name: PALM TREE POSE

tips.text: Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your back straight.
This exercise stretches your entire body and improves your balance.
Inhale to stretch up, exhale to lower back.

introduce: Start on all fours. Exhale as you lift your hips into an inverted ‘V’ shape, and lengthen your spine.\n\nAlternately lift and lower your heels with steady breath.
name: WALK THE DOG

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Relax your neck.
Keep a steady and even breathing rhythm without holding your breath.
Notice the elongation from your fingertips to your sit bone.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Please press all areas of the palms equally on the floor.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, hamstrings, calves, and arches.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended and feet together. Place your arms close to your body and palms facing down.

Exhale, press your elbows and forearms into the floor to lift your head and upper back off the floor. Lower your head backward and rest the crown of your head on the mat.

Hold this position. Inhale to expand your chest, exhale to soften your chest and shoulders.
name: FISH POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Too much pressure on your head or neck? You can put a little more weight on your arms.
This exercise helps ease tensions in your spine and neck.
This exercise opens your chest and strengthens your back and shoulders.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to soften your chest and shoulders.

introduce:
Stand with your feet wide apart. Turn your left foot out and your right foot slightly in.

Exhale as you bend your left knee until your thigh is almost parallel to the floor. Inhale as you raise your arms out to the sides at shoulder height. 

Exhale, bend your body forward and lower your left arm so your forearm rests on your left thigh. Extend your right arm overhead in line with your torso. Look up at the ceiling.

Hold this position. Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to relax and deepen the side stretch.
name: EXTENDED SIDE ANGLE LEFT

tips.text: Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Don\'t let your knee go over your toes.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.
Put your weight mainly on your legs instead of your elbow.
This exercise strengthens your shoulders, thighs, and glutes.
This exercise stretches your groins, hamstrings, waist, and shoulders.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the side stretch.

introduce:
Stand with your feet wide apart. Turn your right foot out and your left foot slightly in.

Exhale as you bend your right knee until your thigh is almost parallel to the floor. Inhale as you raise your arms out to the sides at shoulder height. 

Exhale, bend your body forward and lower your right arm so your forearm rests on your right thigh. Extend your left arm overhead in line with your torso. Look up at the ceiling.

Hold this position. Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to relax and deepen the side stretch.
name: EXTENDED SIDE ANGLE RIGHT

tips.text: Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Don't let your knee go over your toes.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.
Put your weight mainly on your legs instead of your elbow.
This exercise strengthens your shoulders, thighs, and glutes.
This exercise stretches your groins, hamstrings, waist, and shoulders.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to deepen the side stretch.

introduce:
Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart. 

Fold your body forward. Interlace your fingers behind you and straighten your arms. 

Bring your arms forward. Hold this position.
name: STANDING FORWARD BEND WITH SHOULDER OPENER

tips.text: Breathe naturally.
Keep your neck relaxed.
This exercise helps increase the mobility of your shoulders.

introduce:
Sit on the mat. Bend your knees and stack your left knee over your right. 

Raise your left arm overhead. Bend your left elbow and place your left hand between your shoulder blades. Make sure your left elbow is pointing toward the ceiling. 

Bend your right elbow and reach your hands toward each other until they touch. Clasp your hands or fingers if possible. Hold this position.
name: COW FACE LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
If your hands can't touch each other, you can grab a towel.
Breathe naturally.
Don't twist your spine.
Don't lean your head and body to the side.
Keep your spine straight.

introduce:
Sit on the mat. Bend your knees and stack your right knee over your left. 

Raise your right arm overhead. Bend your right elbow and place your right hand between your shoulder blades. Make sure your right elbow is pointing toward the ceiling. 

Bend your left elbow and reach your hands toward each other until they touch. Clasp your hands or fingers if possible. Hold this position.
name: COW FACE RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
If your hands can't touch each other, you can grab a towel.
Breathe naturally.
Don't twist your spine.
Don't lean your head and body to the side.
Keep your spine straight.

introduce:
Sit on your heels with your knees hip-width apart. 

Take a deep inhale and walk your hands forward, keeping your hips stacked over your knees. Exhale as you lower your chest and forehead toward the mat, and lift your hips stacked above your knees.

Hold this position with slow, steady breaths. Inhale as you lengthen your spine. On each exhale, let your chest sink deeper, releasing the shoulders and upper back.
name: PUPPY DOG POSE

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Inhale to lengthen your spine.  Exhale to sink your chest closer to the mat.
Keep your hips directly above your knees.
This exercise helps stretch your upper body and tight shoulders.

introduce:
Lie on your stomach with legs straight. Extend your left arm out to the side with your palm facing down in line with your shoulder.

Inhale, then exhale as you roll your body to the right. Place your right foot behind your left leg for support. Keep your head slightly lifted, neck in line with the spine.

Hold this position. Inhale to open the chest, exhale to relax into the stretch.
name: OPEN WING POSE LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.
Inhale to open the chest. Exhale to relax into the stretch.
This pose helps relieve stress and tension throughout your shoulders.

introduce:
Lie on your stomach with legs straight. Extend your right arm out to the side with your palm facing down in line with your shoulder.

Inhale, then exhale as you roll your body to the left. Place your left foot behind your right leg for support. Keep your head slightly lifted, neck in line with the spine.

Hold this position. Inhale to open the chest, exhale to relax into the stretch.
name: OPEN WING POSE RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.
Inhale to open the chest. Exhale to relax into the stretch.
This pose helps relieve stress and tension throughout your shoulders.

introduce:
Sit up straight on the mat with your legs straight ahead. 

Inhale, lift your chest slightly. Exhale, bend and widen your knees, cross your legs at the shins, and let your hips settle. Place your hands on your knees, palms down.

Hold the position. Inhale, gently lift your torso; exhale, relax your shoulders and soften your hips.
name: EASY POSE

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Inhale to lift your torso. Exhale to relax your shoulders and hips.
This pose will help you to calm and relax.
